note: LEG-002. Every dependency whose licence (or a native library bundled in its wheel) is weak / strong / network copyleft, proprietary or unknown must be listed here with how Formwright uses it. scripts/sbom.py --check (and tests/test_sbom.py) fail on any flagged dependency missing from this list, or whose licence class got worse than max_class. Adding an AGPL/SSPL (network-copyleft) or GPL (strong-copyleft) entry needs a founder decision (PD row) and counsel (LEG-003/LEG-004).

entries.name: cadquery-ocp-novtk
entries.license: Apache-2.0 (bindings); bundles OCCT LGPL-2.1-only WITH OCCT-exception-1.0, FreeImage (FIPL option), LibRaw (LGPL-2.1/CDDL-1.0), FreeType (FTL option)
entries.usage: The CAD kernel. Python bindings load the unmodified OCCT shared libraries shipped in the wheel (dynamic linking). Formwright does not modify OCCT. Runs server-side (SaaS); nothing is distributed to customers today. If a desktop app or plugin ever ships these libraries, LGPL obligations apply (offer source of OCCT, allow relinking/replacement of the shared libraries, keep notices). Counsel review: LEG-003.

entries.name: certifi
entries.usage: CA certificate bundle used unmodified by HTTP clients (requests/httpx). MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: obligations only if certifi's own files are modified and distributed. We do neither.

entries.name: claude-agent-sdk
entries.license: MIT (SDK); bundles the Claude Code CLI executable under Anthropic's commercial terms
entries.usage: Design agent runtime. The bundled CLI runs as a separate subprocess; it is not linked into or redistributed with Formwright. Use is governed by Anthropic's terms (dev: founder's Claude Code login; production: API key, PD-09 / AGT-015).

entries.name: pathspec
entries.usage: Development only (mypy dependency): never deployed or distributed.

entries.name: @fontsource-variable/inter
entries.usage: The Inter web font, served unmodified with the web app. OFL allows bundling and embedding; only modified fonts must stay OFL and must not use the reserved name. We do not modify it.
